name: managedMobileDeviceCount
definition: Number of mobile devices the device management tool reports as enrolled and managed.
population: mobile devices (iOS, iPadOS, Android) that the device management tool itself lists as managed
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete device list with a managed or enrolled state read for every mobile device; the count is a measurement, so an unreadable list is not measured rather than zero.

changeLog.change: Registered with the first NinjaOne implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; field names confirmed against a read-only device list, but no tenant body replayed through the transform, so V0). Intune and Lookout already emit this key.
